dict.string: Shift captures the area you select for screenshots and screen recordings.
Shift can include microphone audio in screen recordings when you enable it.
Shift saves processed files to the folder you choose, including folders on your Desktop.
Shift saves processed files to the folder you choose, including folders in Documents.
Shift saves processed files to the folder you choose, including Downloads.
Shift can process and save files on removable volumes you select.
Shift can process and save files on network volumes you select.
